facts.fact: BusinessDay quotes NIMC saying the NINAuth National Identification Number authentication platform is fully operational, with the migration of telecom operators onto it finished in July 2025.
NIMC says all telecom operators now use NINAuth to verify SIM registration, swap, migration and retrieval requests, and that it offers single sign-on access to services.

systems.tiers: NIN authentication platform with single sign-on

NGA.note: Nothing on civil register and ID links.
Data protection is mentioned in general terms; no law, authority or decision is named.
No count of people holding a NIN.
Nothing on a number at birth.
NIMC developed NINAuth, but who runs and owns the national ID system is not stated.
Only telecom SIM checks, which are not a public register keyed on the number.
The ID system's issuance and security are not described.

facts.fact: NIMC states that telecom operators verify people against the NIN through NINAuth for SIM registration, SIM swap, migration and retrieval requests, with all operators migrated by July 2025.
